newsitem.title: USA: Chateau reaffirms merger with ROC.
newsitem.headline: Chateau reaffirms merger with ROC.

text.p: Mobile home park Chateau Properties Inc. said Thursday it remains committed to a merger with ROC Communities Inc., snubbing a persistent hostile takeover bid by Manufactured Home Communities Inc.

Chateau said its board found a combination with ROC, another mobile home park operator, to be "a clearly superior alternative" and "determined that it would not be appropriate to enter into discussions" with Manufactured Home.
Manufactured Home, controlled by Chicago developer Samuel Zell, Wednesday extended its cash tender offer of $26 per share, worth about $400 million, for Chateau until Oct. 23.
Manufactured Home said about 2.995 million Chateau shares had been tendered as of Tuesday, giving it a total stake of about 51 percent in Clinton Township, Mich.-based Chateau.
Chateau's stock fell 12.5 cents to $25, Englewood, Calif.-based ROC edged down 12.5 cents to $24.50 and Manufactured Home was unchanged at $19.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
